parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must communicate suspension of a Digital Signature Certificate to the subscriber.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority notifies the subscriber of the suspension of their Digital Signature Certificate.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the communication of certificate suspension.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority may revoke a Digital Signature Certificate under specified conditions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to revoke Digital Signature Certificates as per legal requirements.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation outlines the authority of the Certifying Authority to revoke certificates.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must not reject an application unless the applicant is given a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed rejection.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority provides applicants with a reasonable opportunity to present their case before rejecting an application.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures due process in the application review process.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must issue a Digital Signature Certificate upon application, subject to prescribed conditions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to issue Digital Signature Certificates upon valid application.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation outlines the duty of the Certifying Authority to issue certificates upon application.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must charge a fee not exceeding twenty-five thousand rupees for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority charges a fee not exceeding twenty-five thousand rupees for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation sets the maximum fee for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must issue a certification practice statement or a statement containing specified particulars with the application for a Digital Signature Certificate.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority requires applicants to provide a certification practice statement or a statement containing specified particulars.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation mandates the submission of specific documentation with the application for a Digital Signature Certificate.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must certify that the Digital Signature Certificate is issued in accordance with prescribed conditions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority certifies that the Digital Signature Certificate is issued in accordance with prescribed conditions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that the issuance of the certificate is in compliance with legal requirements.

parsed_entries.requirement: Certifying Authority must take action if any event occurs that may materially and adversely affect the integrity of its computer system or the conditions subject to which a Digital Signature Certificate was granted.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to address events that may adversely affect the integrity of its computer system or the conditions of a Digital Signature Certificate.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires the Certifying Authority to act in the event of system integrity or certificate condition issues.
